notes.title: Update - v0.0.8
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Choosing a character and then going back to the home screen would display the wrong character on the character selection screen.
[*] The special ability will no longer trigger when you die.
[*] Fixed screen resizing during gameplay.
[*] Adjusted Shinominya's arrows.
[*] Corrected the Paper Plane's incorrect status (was showing 0 damage at level 1).
[*] Fixed Coffee and Demon Wings not stacking and displaying correct values.
[*] Fixed immortal mobs when reaching level 99.
[*] Mouse cursor is now hidden on level up and configuration screens and displays a crosshair during gameplay.
[*] Fixed minor bugs on the upgrade screen.
[*] Made some text corrections and simplifications.
[*] Bubble attributes have been improved.
[/list]

[h2]Update:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Onirin's initial status has been updated (with the next items, further balancing will occur).
[*] Interface has been updated.
[*] Your configuration settings are now saved (BGM/SFX/Screen shake/Resolution).
[/list]

New content is in development as I check community feedback on bugs, suggestions for changes, and content.

Thank you for the feedback and for playing :)!
